caption_L1: Here a line chart is labeled Philadelphia Eagles revenue from 2001 to 2019 (in million U.S. dollars). The y-axis plots Revenue in million U.S. dollars as linear scale of range 0 to 500 while the x-axis shows Year on linear scale from 2005 to 2015.
caption_L2L3: Since 2001 the new Philadelphia eagles revenue has been rapidly increasing. Between the years 2001 and 2019 revenue has gone from about 100 million dollars to around 500 million dollars, that is an increase of almost 4 times the original amount. The rise each year can be seen as pretty even and steadily growing.
